    simp only [two_mul]
    refine (tendsto_id.add tendsto_id).inf (tendsto_principal_principal.2 fun a (ha : x ≤ a) ↦ ?_)
    simp only [mem_Ici]
    gcongr
  exact (tendsto_pure_pure (fun n ↦ (n + 1) / 2) _).comp <|
    (tendsto_floor_right_pure_floor (2 * x)).comp this
